# Array To Cluster ignores excess elements

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

The configured three fields receive the first three I32 elements in index order. The fourth input element is ignored; no default provider is needed.

## What this example demonstrates

The configured three fields receive the first three I32 elements in index order. The fourth input element is ignored; no default provider is needed.
